title: HTTP source bundle, root measurement and broker readiness components
implementation: Finite checked-source HTTP93 host/guest setup bundle separates original signed-tree bytes from generated installed outputs; host recomposes before copy.
Twelve composed outputs reuse six setup helpers, three HTTP measurement consumers and three new host/guest/replay replacements.
Guest observes owned boot/network namespace before eight-writer setup;21-directory custody handoff includes opt and src paths.
HTTP root measurement provisioning joins endpoint/canary/policy/fixture credential/accounts/boot/21 source pins under held custody; no create-inode surrogate or endpoint contact.
Broker startup readiness has fixed GET, durable absent-only claim before connection, credential recheck, bounded partial outcomes and cleanup before READY.
Independent readiness consumer joins raw request/claim/result/sink pins, nonce, source port, expected process identities and CLOCK_BOOTTIME; whole-service readiness remains false.
review_corrections_before_first_test: Recheck protected readiness credential after the probe.
Complete outer broker process/namespace cleanup before publishing READY.
Preserve interruption and indeterminate observations when result publication fails.
Require same-current-process broker listener witness in future capture integration, not merely Type=simple MainPID or persisted READY.
next: Compose readiness-capable HTTP94 successor and corresponding activator/source/measurement/installed-identity pins; preserve HTTP93.
Bind readiness credential explicitly; join same-process broker listener after successful startup.
Reuse existing common-attempt public/private evidence lifecycle for one newly necessary combined guarded capture, not another nonresumable setup-only capture.
Finish remaining admission, RUN/sensor-health and workload/pair adapters, complete verifier inventory, then freeze and required fresh acceptance.
limitations: Inert component checks do not prove installation, activation, live readiness, measurement, admission, RUN or Phase3 qualification.
Public setup replay checks retained joins, not independent generated-code execution or private writer semantics.
Readiness raw replay proves only a conditional broker-process round-trip join; independently observed current process/listener and installed-source evidence are still required.
HTTP93 staged files and prior evidence remain unchanged; new readiness startup code is not installed by that frozen profile.
